title: 295 lbs (130 kg) pause squats for 6
summary: This is following 365lbs high bar squats x5 + x4 and 285lbs front squats for 4x3. Last three squat sessions were plagued with lower back spasms so I'm very happy to have completed all this leg volume with 0 pain (I detail my pain management strategy in one of my videos.) 28 inches legs here I come!
